record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The eight units in appliesTo declare HORN_LEECH: four Deerling forms (1 star) and four Sawsbuck forms (2 stars). All declare passive SEASONAL, which is NOT covered here (the queue marks it as having no PassiveEffects entry; see the passive/SEASONAL record). The strategy is shared; the unit differences are the star count (table index) and stats such as atk.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target equal to a star multiplier (2 / 2 / 3 / 5 for 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 stars; the listed units are 1 and 2 stars, so x2) times the caster's current attack, then requests a heal of round(50 %) of the takenDamage value returned by that call (the shield-absorbed part plus the HP lost, capped at current HP; 0 when blocked; the Cover Band cover ally's result when a lethal hit is redirected). Separately it requests a shield of round(50 %) of an 'overheal' computed from the UNMODIFIED heal and the caster's HP before healing, whether or not the heal request had any effect. A wounded caster receives no HP heal, but the shared Blood Moon / Blood Stone branch of handleHeal can still request a compensating shield.

targeting.who: the cast target chosen before the cast (the strategy never changes it); requiresTarget is true
targeting.note: No movement and no retargeting in the strategy. The heal goes to the caster only.

effects.scaling: raw damage = multiplier x pokemon.atk at the moment of the cast (atk buffs count); then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: intermediate, not guaranteed final HP damage: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, min 1) among other steps. takenDamage returned by handleSpecialDamage -> PokemonState.handleDamage: 0 when the target is dead or resurrecting, protected or skydiving (handleSpecialDamage also returns 0 for magicBounce); otherwise the part absorbed by the shield (with flinch both the shield part and the residual are ceil(0.5 x reduced); Protective Pads on the attacker double the shield part before it is capped at the shield, the excess moving to the residual) plus min(residual, current HP), rounded; the Shiny Charm branch resets it to 0; the Fossil branch ADDS min(0.5 x shield, residual) on top of the HP part; a Cover Band redirect returns the cover ally's own result (its defenses, shield and HP), while the original target keeps no HP loss but has already lost the shield part. Blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (takenDamage 0). The heal and the shield input below follow this value.

effects.scaling: Math.round(0.5 x takenDamage); handleHeal is called with apBoost 0 and crit false, so no AP or crit scaling, but the heal then passes handleHeal's modifiers: none if the caster is wounded or protected, x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burned, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 under ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP
effects.resolution: handleHeal passes the heal through its modifiers: a wounded caster receives no HP heal (healReceived 0), but under BLOODMOON weather with a Blood Stone the same call first requests a shield of round(0.3 x stones x heal); nothing for a protected or dead caster; x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH, rounded, capped at missing HP; overheal inside handleHeal (modified heal minus missing HP) on a GRASS-synergy unit adds max HP (pokemon-state.ts:373-375), a separate path from the strategy's shield. Pinned-helper probe (raw 100, taken 100, heal 50): caster 990/1000 -> HP 1000 and shield 20; wounded or protected -> HP stays 990 and shield 20; burned -> heal halved, shield still 20; full-HP caster -> shield 25.

shields.scaling: overheal = max(0, round(0.5 x takenDamage) - (maxHP - hp)) using the UNMODIFIED heal and the HP before healing; shield = Math.round(0.5 x overheal) via addShield(…, 0, false): no AP or crit scaling; halved if the caster is enraged; passes the entity's Big Eater Belt hook (x1.25 rounded down for a holder) before the enraged halving and rounding in PokemonState.addShield
shields.condition: only when overheal > 0, i.e. when the unmodified heal exceeds the caster's missing HP
shields.note: because overheal ignores handleHeal's modifiers (wound, burn, enraged, ZENITH), a wounded caster still gets the shield computed from the unmodified heal even though it received no heal

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (3) and 4-star (5) columns are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the eight units (1 and 2). Deerling and Sawsbuck therefore both declare the x2 multiplier; their different damage comes only from stats (atk). Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy. The cast needs a target (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast reads the caster's current atk and HP.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: multiplier 2 (1 and 2 stars) x atk. The damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then an intermediate SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; the heal request is round(50 % x takenDamage) (shield part + HP part, or the cover ally's result under Cover Band) before handleHeal's modifiers; the shield request is round(50 % x overheal) with overheal = max(0, unmodified heal - missing HP), independent of whether the heal took effect (wound, protect, burn).
